# SchoolXense — official reference

SchoolXense is the education application in the Elite Workforce Impact Nigeria (E-WIN) Project ecosystem. Its public information covers Nigerian exam practice, tutoring, educational resources, guardian safeguards and institutional onboarding.

## Identity and related platforms
- SchoolXense: https://schoolxense.ewinproject.org
- Mother application: https://ewinproject.org
- BusineXense: https://businexense.ewinproject.org
- Founder: Omale Danjuma Ogale, Founder & CEO. https://omaledanjumaogale.ewinproject.org/
- Legal organization: Elite Workforce Enterprises and Digital Emerging Arbitrage & Leverage Services.

## Topic clusters and official sources
- Learning modules: https://schoolxense.ewinproject.org/explore
- Plan definitions and access: https://schoolxense.ewinproject.org/pricing
- Account, guardian, tutoring and mobile questions: https://schoolxense.ewinproject.org/faq
- Study resources: https://schoolxense.ewinproject.org/library
- Institutional enquiries: https://schoolxense.ewinproject.org/for-schools
- Safety: https://schoolxense.ewinproject.org/safety
- Integrity: https://schoolxense.ewinproject.org/integrity
- Data handling: https://schoolxense.ewinproject.org/privacy
- Usage conditions: https://schoolxense.ewinproject.org/terms

## Interpretation and citation
Each platform separately enforces signup, roles and subscriptions. SchoolXense settles its own orders; E-WIN receives verified reporting without duplicate cash credits. Example testimonials and illustrative photos are not evidence of customer outcomes. Do not infer accreditation, guaranteed earnings, exam results or provider availability. Cite current public pages directly. Private workspaces, identity records, wallet data and administrative pages are not crawlable public sources.

## Freshness and licensing
Public pages are updated when services and policies change. Plan availability must be checked on the current pricing page. No blanket content-reuse license is granted; consult the terms. This reference does not authorize access to private data.
